findings: components[0].text and formation.text: 木 is described as contributing a “vessel-related category,” but the cited analysis supports 木 as the semantic element without establishing that specific category contribution. Say that 木 is the semantic component, or qualify the vessel-category interpretation as speculative.

learner.overview: “An older account” assigns 否 to related 桮, which implies a chronology the evidence does not establish. Describe it as the received Shuowen account, and retain that it concerns 桮 rather than modern 杯.
